skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concepts and structure of agricultural supply chains, including logistics and components.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Principles of agribusiness supply chain management
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Grasp fundamental principles of managing agricultural supply chains, including internal issues and support systems.
Explain economic relationships within agricultural supply chains based on theoretical foundations.
Analyze and compare the performance of various agents participating in agricultural supply chains.
Analyze and explain the effectiveness of various support systems for managing agricultural supply chains.
Recognize and adhere to legal regulations regarding the management of agricultural supply chains.
Demonstrate ability to work independently and collaboratively in selecting topics and solving problems related to agricultural supply chains.
Show initiative in studying, researching, and working in groups.
Identify and analyze problems in agricultural supply chains and present solutions effectively.
